ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 80-85% of the surface area, contrasted against low-intensity black margins and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central region; solid black continuous banding along the trailing edge and median notch; dark mottled clusters localized at the distal tips and lower base; sparse, isolated dark circular spots in the right-central lobe area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with an approximate 30-degree interior angle; vertical depth is approximately 1/8th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; distinct high-amplitude jagged peaks visible near the terminal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch transitioning into a broader convexity towards the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark circular clusters at both distal tips; small dark pixel clusters scattered across the right fluke surface indicating barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent diagonal reddish-brown linear mark on the right lobe; multiple smaller, dark, non-aligned rake marks distributed across the central-left and central-right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct reddish-brown diagonal linear scar on the right lobe; irregular jagged notches and tissue loss along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: A vertical alignment of three dark circular points located directly below the base of the median notch.
